Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

nycha 0.0.1.9001

  • nyc_addresses_df documents how its address points differ from 311’s street-centerline geocodes, and recommends joining on bbl (or bin) rather than by distance or development polygon.

  • Identifier fields no longer contain thousands separators. The NYC Open Data exports format some identifier fields as numbers, e.g. ZIP code "10,456" and BBL "4,021,590,002". This affected zip_code, lot, and census_tract_2020 in nyc_addresses_df and nyc_addresses_sf, and bin, bbl, and census_tract in nyc_facilities_df and nyc_facilities_sf. These values can now be joined to other data.

  • nyc_addresses_df, nyc_addresses_sf, nyc_facilities_df, and nyc_facilities_sf have a new tract_geoid column, the 11-digit 2020 census tract GEOID, assigned from each row’s coordinates. The source tract columns use two different encodings.

  • privately_managed in nyc_addresses_df and nyc_addresses_sf is now FALSE, not NA, for properties that are not privately managed.

nycha 0.0.1.9000
